exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Historical Silent Storm soft PAINTED diffuse COLOR effect source bitmap, faithful higher resolution shade; not new physical smoke/fire/object rendering.

Image1 is the EXACT ENTIRE native storedRGB source, solely whole NEAREST enlargement to512, made opaque to expose original color. Preserve COMPLETE edge-to-edge normalizedUV/field positions/shapes/count/phase/nativepaintscale/palette/relativeweak strengths. Keep original SOFT BLUR and smooth subdued painted shade. Final FULL ORIGINALalpha is restored independently and brightness only ONE global numeric scalar. No padding/crop/cutout/fitting. The nearest support visible sourcepixel sampling is only for exactUV: do not add squaredcells/grid/mosaic/granules or coarse mottledpaint. Render same gently blurred source tones, never make cells/stipples visible.

Native32x32 source has EXACT FOUR existing softly blurred DARK GRAY paint fields: original upper-right field nativeapproximately[14,1,28,14], left-center[1,9,14,20], stronger lower-center[6,17,21,32] and VERY WEAK lower-right[22,19,31,30]. Keep exact complete asymmetric silhouettes/positions/width/phase/scale and all original faint nativepixels beyond these fields. Lower-right stays extremely faint, not omitted or strengthened into a brighter new fragment. These are source painttone footprints, NOT a request to draw physical feathers or clouds. SourceRGB is dim MAX53/54/57 and originalalpha0..81, notwhite; do not brighten cores locally. Preserve smooth original darkgray softness, relative hierarchy and black gaps; no new strands/fibers/featherbarbs/veins/rockgeometry or differentmaterial, no added stipples/cells/cloudlobes/dots.

Exact original wholeRGBA extrema are [[0, 53], [0, 54], [0, 57], [0, 81]]. Preserve actual dim sourcechannel maxima/relative localstrength, not manual255 or cosmeticcontrast. No newparticles/forms/rays/tongues/flecks/photonoise/paintgrain/hairfibers/raisedrims/highlights/whiteglints/text/symbols. Source is deliberately soft, no highpass/sharpenededges.

Output ONLY ENTIRE SAME opaqueRGB square canvas, identical wholeUV/no frame/whitespace/padding/recenter/crop/zoom/BBox/repacking/artistpatches. Entire originalsourceA/nativeType restored downstream, no sourcealpha or composition changes.
